method: Two existing normal public-command legacy-rules-11 campaign traces are replayed in the current engine. The current actual hunt UI is booted once per reached phase for each trace, plus the first hunter state in each chapter. All four policy-adoption helpers are identity functions during UI boot. No buttons are clicked.
limitations: These are historical released-rules-11 traces, not fresh current-policy playthroughs or the parent's cloud-only dev.17 save.
The lightweight DOM harness does not render CSS, Phaser sprites, modal geometry, animation frames or physical pointer input.
Action presence means rendered DOM elements in the decision/reward areas; this does not establish visibility, enabled validity or completion of every branch.
Only one representative of each reached phase per trace is booted, plus later-chapter hunter states. No claim of every registered phase or every possible state within a phase is made.
Title, setup, help, file export/import interactions and native save/load are outside this pass and are being checked separately by the parent.

existingEvidenceLimit: The seven previously existing UI references were verified by reading their source; they were not rerun in this scratch pass. Four additional phase contracts were subsequently added in the single new test file and their seven branch checks were executed separately. This does not change the original 22-phase/43-render-sample result or claim 33 phases were played through end to end.
